source_concerns.issue: 「Qualcomm Technologles,Inc.」: Technologies misspelt and no space after the comma
no space after ® in 「USB Type-C®and USB-C®are」
double space in 「trademarks of  Qualcomm」
「⎓8A max, double to 8A max」: the doubled value equals the single-input value (the 17.5-60V line doubles 12A to 24A)
source_concerns.disposition: preserved verbatim; source owner to confirm the rating

source_concerns.issue: 「AC 120V~ 60Hz」 has no comma, unlike 「AC 120V, 60Hz」 in the output row
double space in 「USB-C  Output」; 「DC Input Port( 2×DC8020, … input )」 spacing inside the parentheses
source_concerns.disposition: preserved verbatim in the panel and alt text

source_concerns.issue: the overview calls the button 「LCD Screen Button」 while the operation text calls it 「DISPLAY Button」
legend number 10 is printed as plain 「10」 while every other legend number (and 10 in the LCD map) is circled
source_concerns.disposition: printed marker kept as 「10」; source owner review

source_concerns.issue: 「the product turns the Low Power Mode off by default」 then describes the 12-hour shutdown as the default behaviour, and the legend and LCD icon are 12H
source_concerns.disposition: preserved verbatim; source owner to confirm the default

source_concerns.issue: ideographic commas 「、」 between the fault codes F0-F7 in English copy; 「after-sales treatment; If F6」 capitalised after a semicolon
title case differs: 「High-temperature warning」 vs 「Low-temperature Warning」 (legend: High/Low Temperature Warning)
double space in 「Or,  if there is no operation」
no space after the colon in 「Tip:During」
「theDC8020」 missing space; the sentence 「If three or four solar panels are connected,」 breaks into a new paragraph 「please refer to …」
source_concerns.disposition: preserved verbatim, two paragraphs as printed; source owner review

source_concerns.issue: double spaces after 「SolarSaga 80」 (twice); 「supports the input to up to 12 pieces」
「adapter」 in the copy vs 「Adaptor」 in the heading, package list and drawing labels
「output port(DC8020 male, with DC8020 to DC7909 Adaptor)」 no space before the parenthesis; 「Parallel port（DC 8020 female）」 uses full-width parentheses and 「DC 8020」 with a space
source_concerns.disposition: preserved in the panel and alt text
